news.title: Wanted woman from Georgia arrested in Tennessee, authorities say
news.summary: The Tennessee Highway Patrol said 34-year-old Roschey Brantley was wanted by Atlanta police in connection with a homicide investigation.

news.title: 2 killed, 3 hurt in head-on crash on Highway 5 in Douglas County
news.summary: Two people are dead and three others, including two children, are hospitalized following a head-on crash on Highway 5 in Douglas County on Wednesday afternoon.

news.title: 2 die in head-on crash in metro Atlanta
news.summary: Two people are dead and three people were taken to the hospital in a head-on crash in Douglas County Wednesday afternoon.

news.title: Guatemalan duo extradited to Georgia over alleged attempted cocaine trafficking
news.summary: Two men accused of trying to bring 330 pounds of cocaine into the Atlanta area have been extradited from Guatemala to face federal charges.

news.title: Search for suspect accused of stealing $1,900 in medication from CVS

news.title: 'So much confusion': Wife of gas station employee killed in Atlanta wants answers as family mourns loss
news.summary: Eniyew Yehuala was shot and killed last Tuesday while working at a Chevron gas station on Cascade Ave.

news.title: Woman found dead behind abandoned Bartow County house identified
news.summary: Authorities are investigating the death of 36-year-old Allison Lynn Anderson after a 911 caller found her body Monday morning in the yard of an abandoned home.

news.title: 3 missing runaway boys found safe in Atlanta, Cobb police say
news.summary: Three boys who were reported as missing runaways have been found in Atlanta.

news.title: Rapper Rod Wave indicted on gun, drug charges after Atlanta arrest
